header: Talbrunn Lokal: licences that never expire
lead: Practices that must keep patient data on their own computers buy this edition once. The licence never expires; if you end the optional maintenance contract, only updates stop.
note: One-off prices per licence, excluding VAT. Optional maintenance costs 18% of the price per year. Austrian law applies; transfers need our written consent.

tiers.title: Einzelplatz
tiers.text: One workstation and one practitioner at one address. Includes the installer, one year of updates and two hours of remote setup.

tiers.title: Praxislizenz
tiers.text: Up to five workstations at one address, with unlimited practitioner accounts. Includes a test installation for training.

tiers.title: Verbundlizenz
tiers.text: Up to 15 workstations at up to three addresses of one practice owner, sharing one database on your own server.

tiers.title: Schullizenz
tiers.text: For teaching at one campus, with unlimited classroom seats. Sample data only: this licence does not allow real patient data.
